lookback_source.quote: Days—Enter the number of days therapy services were provided in the last 7 days.

lookback_notes: The item form and coding instructions specify the last 7 days; the example refers to a "7-day look-back period." The document does not state on this page how the 7 days are counted relative to the ARD.

coding_levels.label: D2. Respiratory Therapy — Days
coding_levels.definition: Record the number of days this therapy was administered for at least 15 minutes a day in the last 7 days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A day of therapy is defined as treatment for 15 minutes or more in the day.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Days of therapy of less than 15 minutes each do not count toward the day count even if the cumulative minutes over the 7-day look-back exceed 15 (example: 50 total minutes across 5 days of 10 minutes each is coded 0 days).

source.quote: Although a total of 50 minutes of respiratory therapy services were provided over the 7-day look-back period, there were not any days that respiratory therapy was provided for 15 minutes or more. Therefore, O0400D equals zero days.
